description_en: Enables SQL throttling to control the numbers of database access requests and concurrent SQL statements
description_zh: 调用EnableSqlConcurrencyControl接口，启用SQL限流来控制数据库请求访问量和SQL并发量
kebab_example: aliyun das enable-sql-concurrency-control --instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --sql-type SELECT --max-concurrency 3 --sql-keywords 'call~open~api~test~4~from~POP' --concurrency-control-time 300 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableSqlConcurrencyControl

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID only if your database instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL和 PolarDB MySQL版实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statements. Valid values:

SELECT

UPDATE

DELETE
parameters.help_zh:
选择SQL的类型。取值：
SELECT
UPDATE
DELETE
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of concurrent SQL statements. Set this parameter to a positive integer.

When the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain the specified keywords reaches this upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered
parameters.help_zh:
SQL最大并发数，取值为大于或等于1的整数。
当包含关键词的SQL达到最大并发数时会触发限流规则
parameters.name: max_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The keywords that are used to identify the SQL statements that need to be throttled.

If you specify multiple SQL keywords, separate them with tildes (\~). If the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain all the specified SQL keywords reaches the specified upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered
parameters.help_zh:
需要限流的SQL关键词。
多个关键词间用波浪线（~）分隔，SQL语句中需要同时包含这些关键词才会触发限流规则
parameters.name: sql_keywords

parameters.help_en:
The duration within which the SQL throttling rule takes effect. Unit: seconds.

The throttling rule takes effect only within this duration
parameters.help_zh:
SQL限流的生效时长，单位为秒。
限流规则仅在生效时间内开启
parameters.name: concurrency_control_time

Data.description_en: The detailed information, including the error codes and the number of entries that are returned
Data.description_zh: 详细信息列表，包括信息总数、错误码等

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败
